title: Helper Trucks for Kids! Fire Truck, Ambulance and More
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're meeting five helper trucks that keep our town happy and safe.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!

lines: Here's our first truck. Here's a clue: it's red and has a tall ladder! Can you guess?
A fire truck carries ladders, hoses and lots of water.
Firefighters ride in it to help keep everyone safe.
Can you climb a pretend ladder? Up, up, up!
Can you guess? Are all fire trucks red?
Most are red, but some fire trucks are yellow, or even green!
Let's say it together: FIRE TRUCK!
Fire trucks have bright lights so everyone can see them coming.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it takes people to the hospital! Can you guess?
An ambulance carries helpers called paramedics.
It has a bed with wheels inside, called a stretcher.
Can you wave to say thank you to the helpers?
Can you guess why the word on the front looks backward?
So drivers can read it the right way in their mirror!
When you hear a siren, cars move over to let it pass.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has red and blue lights on top! Can you guess?
Police officers drive police cars around the neighborhood.
They help people and keep the neighborhood safe.
Can you flash your hands like twinkly lights? Flash, flash!
Can you guess what colors the lights flash?
Red and blue! The lights help other cars see it.
Let's say it together: POLICE CAR!
You can always wave hello to a police officer.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it picks up the trash cans every week! Can you guess?
A garbage truck takes trash away to keep our streets clean.
Inside, it squishes the trash, so it can fit lots more.
Can you squish like a garbage truck? Squish!
Can you guess how it picks up the bin?
Some garbage trucks have a robot arm that lifts the bin up high!
Let's say it together: GARBAGE TRUCK!
Recycling trucks take cans and paper to be made into new things.
Who's last? Here's a clue: it's big and yellow, and takes kids to school! Can you guess?
A school bus has lots of seats for kids.
It's yellow so everyone can see it easily.
Can you sit up tall like you're riding the bus?
Can you guess what swings out when the bus stops?
A little stop sign! It tells cars to wait.
Let's say it together: SCHOOL BUS!
Then kids can get on and off safely.

recap: The ambulance word reads right in a mirror.
Police car lights flash red and blue.
The garbage truck has a robot arm.
And the school bus has a stop sign!
outro: Which helper truck was your favorite? Be kind, and wave hello to the trucks you see.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
